privacy.title: What web search sends
privacy.intro: When you search the web, Chimera sends your question (or short search queries written from it) to the search engine, then this server downloads the pages it finds.

engine.searxng: This server uses its own SearXNG instance, which passes queries on to public search engines without your account details. This keeps third parties to a minimum.
engine.brave: This server uses the Brave Search API, so queries are sent to Brave.
engine.tavily: This server uses the Tavily API, so queries are sent to Tavily.

privacy.sites: Websites see this server's IP address, not yours. Your conversation and account details are never sent to them.
privacy.links: Links you paste are downloaded the same way.

admin.title: Web access for everyone
admin.help: Lets models read links and search the web. Pages are downloaded by this server, and only when a user pastes a link or turns on search.
admin.enabledHelp: When off, links are never read and search is unavailable for all users.
admin.engineHelp: Self-hosted SearXNG keeps queries away from commercial search APIs. API engines need a key.
admin.searxngUrlHelp: For example http://searxng:8080 with the Docker Compose profile. JSON output must be enabled in its settings.yml.
admin.authHeaderHelp: Only if SearXNG is behind a proxy that requires a header, for example X-Api-Key.
admin.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.queryGeneration: Let the model write search queries
admin.queryGenerationHelp: When off, or when the model's reply isn't usable, the user's message is searched as written.
admin.promptHelp: Placeholders: {date}, {weekday}, {time}, {timezone}; for queries also {conversation}, {message}, {max_queries}. A security notice about untrusted web text is always added.
admin.allowlist: Internal hosts that may be read
admin.allowlistHelp: One host name or network (CIDR) per line, for example wiki.home.arpa or 10.0.5.0/24. Private, local and cloud-metadata addresses are blocked otherwise.
admin.portsHelp: Comma-separated. Internal hosts allowed above may use any port.
admin.sitesHelp: One domain per line; subdomains are included. Leave the second list empty to allow all other sites.
admin.robotsHelp: Links a user pastes are treated like a browser visit and are read regardless.
admin.total: Characters of web text per answer
admin.browserHelp: Renders pages that only show their content with JavaScript. It runs in its own isolated container and reaches the web only through Chimera's filter, with the same rules as normal page reading.

browserStatus.notConfigured: Not set up. Start the browser profile and set CHIMERA_BROWSER_URL and CHIMERA_BROWSER_SECRET (see docs/WEB.md).
browserStatus.unreachable: The browser service is set up but not reachable. Pages are read without it.
browserStatus.unauthorized: The browser service rejected Chimera's secret. Check that CHIMERA_BROWSER_SECRET matches on both.

admin.browserEnabledHelp: Lets people render pages with it, from a source's details.
admin.browserAuto: Render pages that need JavaScript automatically
admin.browserAutoHelp: When a page turns out to be an empty JavaScript app, it is rendered instead. Slower and uses more memory than normal reading.
admin.autoSearchHelp: In Auto mode the model decides for each message whether to search. This costs one extra short request to the model per message that doesn't search. When off, conversations set to Auto don't search.
admin.autoPrompt: Instructions for deciding whether to search
